{"metadata":{"description":"A three-column workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web: navigation on the left, files and terminals in the middle, and the native DSH conversation on the right.","id":"gh:1343299585","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-workbench-layout","slug":"lsq-dsh-plugins/dsh-workbench-layout","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A three-column workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web: navigation on the left, files and terminals in th"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"e middle, and the native DSH conversation on the right."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Workbench Layout"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"简体中文 | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A three-column workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web: navigation on the left, files and terminals in th"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e middle, and the native DSH conversation on the right."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH Workbench Layout rearranges the official DSH AppFrame without replacing its conversation or comp"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"oser. Files, Git state, editor tabs, and terminals follow the selected Workspace; chat remains owned"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" by the current Session."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Area | What it provides |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Left sidebar | Sessions, file explorer, Git changes and Commit Graph, terminal list |
| Middle edi"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"tor | Multiple file tabs, Markdown preview, per-file Diff, interactive terminals |
| Right column | "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"The original DSH conversation, task status, tools, and composer |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The layout, icons, colors, menus, dialogs, tooltips, and responsive behavior reuse DSH components an"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"d design tokens wherever the official client exposes them."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Files and Markdown"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Browse directories lazily and create, rename, or delete files and folders.
- Color file-tree entri"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"es and middle-editor tabs from Workspace Git state: untracked, deleted, or conflicted files are red;"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" added files are green; modified and renamed files use the warning color. Untracked state decorates "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"only the file itself; directories aggregate the highest-priority remaining descendant state.
- Compa"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"re the editable source buffer with Git `HEAD` and show additions in green, modifications in blue, an"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"d deletion positions in red in a clickable change gutter without tinting code content. Click a marke"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"r to open a local Unified Diff with context, paired old/new line numbers, `-`/`+` rows, and characte"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"r-level change emphasis, navigate between changes, or revert only that block; a revert changes the d"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"raft and remains undoable. Drag the popup's right edge to resize its width, or focus the edge and us"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"e the arrow keys; the viewport-safe width is remembered across changes, files, and page reloads. Pre"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"ssing outside closes the popup. Staged, unstaged, and unsaved edits are combined, then refreshed whi"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"le typing, after saves or external changes, and across branch switches. Rendered Markdown Preview st"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"ays clean; the markers appear in Source mode.
- Open multiple files in one tab strip; use the mouse "},{"id":"p12s14","text":"wheel over overflowing tabs to scroll horizontally.
- Save the active file with `Ctrl/Cmd + S`. Writ"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"es use DSH version tokens so an externally changed file is not silently overwritten.
- While the pag"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"e is visible, open files are checked in one batch about once a second, with an immediate check when "},{"id":"p12s17","text":"focus returns. Clean tabs update automatically; a dirty draft receives explicit Reload or Keep Curre"},{"id":"p12s18","text":"nt choices after an external change.
- The editor compares CodeMirror's canonical text and preserves"},{"id":"p12s19","text":" the file's existing CRLF, LF, or CR style when saving, preventing line-ending normalization from cr"},{"id":"p12s20","text":"eating a false yellow dirty marker.
- Open Markdown in rendered Preview mode by default and switch t"},{"id":"p12s21","text":"o Source when editing.
- Copy workspace-relative or absolute paths from the file context menu.
- Ope"},{"id":"p12s22","text":"n file references produced by DSH tools directly in the middle editor."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Git workspace"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- View staged and unstaged changes as a list or directory tree.
- Stage, unstage, discard, and commi"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"t through explicit actions. Long filenames use the full row at rest, then contract by the exact one-"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" or two-button action width on row hover; direct button hover shows a circular fill.
- Open each wor"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"king-tree, staged, commit, or comparison Diff as its own editor tab.
- Render text Diffs with CodeMi"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"rror MergeView, line numbers, character-level changes, collapsed unchanged regions, always-available"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" Side by side, Unified, and Inline modes, and long-line wrapping.
- Explore local and remote refs as"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" a lane-based Commit Graph with branches, merges, tags, authors, timestamps, and file statistics; ol"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"der commits load automatically in 40-entry pages while scrolling.
- Expand a commit in place, arrang"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"e its files as a list or tree, and open one file at a time.
- Create, switch, rename, and safely del"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"ete local branches; create a branch from a selected ref or commit.
- Configure remotes and run Fetch"},{"id":"p14s11","text":", fast-forward Pull, Push, Publish, and Sync against an upstream or an explicit remote and branch.
-"},{"id":"p14s12","text":" Use commit actions for copying a hash, Cherry-pick, Revert, branch creation, and comparison with th"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"e current Workspace."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Terminals"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Run interactive xterm.js terminals backed by `node-pty` in the selected Workspace root.
- Keep mul"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"tiple terminal sessions beside file and Diff tabs.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Safety and privacy"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- Host APIs resolve an official Workspace id and workspace-relative path; browser-provided absolute "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"paths are not accepted as file targets.
- Traversal outside the Workspace and symbolic-link access a"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"re rejected.
- File creation is atomic, saves use version checks, and rename does not intentionally "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"replace an existing entry.
- External refreshes compare versions through the official DSH filesystem"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" in one batch and never replace an unsaved draft automatically.
- Recursive folder deletion and dest"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ructive Git actions require confirmation. File and folder deletion is permanent.
- Pull and Sync are"},{"id":"p18s7","text":" fast-forward only. Cherry-pick and Revert require a clean worktree and abort automatically when Git"},{"id":"p18s8","text":" reports a conflict.
- Git commands use fixed arguments without a shell, and terminal credential pro"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"mpts are disabled for Git operations.
- Logs use Workspace ids and relative paths instead of recordi"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"ng host file paths.
- A terminal grants shell access to the machine running DSH. Only expose DSH Web"},{"id":"p18s11","text":" to users and networks you trust."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- Open tabs and unsaved drafts live in the current page and are lost on refresh.
- The file editor r"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"eads text files; binary files receive a binary-change notice instead of rendered content.
- Terminal"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" processes end when their tab closes, the page reloads, the connection ends, the Workspace changes, "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"or the plugin stops. The default composition allows up to eight concurrent terminals.
- The plugin r"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"eorders the official AppFrame through stable client markers because DSH does not currently expose a "},{"id":"p20s6","text":"dedicated conversation-column placement API. A future AppFrame rewrite may require a plugin update.
"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"- On very narrow windows, the official AppFrame concession temporarily closes the middle editor and "},{"id":"p20s8","text":"restores it when enough width is available."}],"truncated":true}
